neighbours.label: future-tense 'will' and the slot right after it (also French -ra, Russian будет), predicting what is going to happen
fire: Most drivers in this county will pay more for fuel next year.
The new policy will affect every student at the school.
Floods in the valley will cost the town millions.
This calculator will convert any value to metric.
Her book will be remembered as a classic.
Он сказал, что завтра будет сильный ветер.
Ce disque se vendra très bien en Europe.
The committee will meet again after the summer.
